name: Karnak

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.Instant Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fragility: Gelen saldırıların kritik hasar oranını artırır ve blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır.
abilityDetails.True Strike: Saldırılar Zırh, Direnç, Otomatik Blok ve Kaçışı (Evade) yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Karnak için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
All Will Be As Dust
A stricter training regimen allows Karnak to begin the fight with 1 Focus Charge. Additionally, his Basic Attacks are enhanced in the following ways:
Ignore [30 - 100]% of the opponent's positive Physical Resistance.
When Striking a Block, Passively gain Power equal to [65 - 110]% of what an unblocked Attack would have granted.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Karnak's training and unmatched focus grants him the following:

abilitySections.title: Focus Charges
content: Every 12 seconds, Karnak gains a Focus Charge to a max of 3. Karnak's Focus timer is Paused for 10 seconds each time he's struck and he loses a Charge of Focus if struck by a Special Attack.
2+ Charges: Basic attacks can land Critical Hits into the opponent's Block. Critical Hit based abilities will not trigger through a Block.
3+ Charges: Basic attacks have a 50% chance to inflict a burst of Bleed Damage equal to 35% of the damage dealt by the attack.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Consumes 1 Focus Charge to inflict a stacking 20 second Fragility Debuff. Attacking a Fragile opponent grants +[687.5] Critical Damage Rating and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.
This attack does not consume a Focus Charge if the opponent is intercepted, recovering from the use of a Special Attack, or charging or executing a Heavy Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to gain a True Strike Passive lasting 15 seconds, allowing attacks to ignore Armor, Resistances, Auto-Block and Evade effects. Knocking down the opponent will pause the True Strike Passive for 3 seconds.
While this True Strike is active, Karnak will not stop gaining Focus if he's struck.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to gain a Passive Fury effect, increasing attack by [5,108.5] for 30 seconds.
This Fury is Paused for 5 seconds each time the opponent is Knocked Down.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Disorient Debuff, reducing Block Proficiency by 50% and Defensive Ability Accuracy by 80% for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - All Will Be As Dust
